title: Kai's Vanilla+ Modpack
description: A Modpack i made to have some Vanilla Plus Stuff or Simpler Gameplay.
body:
Kai’s Vanilla+ Modpack makes Minecraft feel fresh without changing the core game.
It includes:

> Small visual upgrades like shaders, glowing ores, falling leaves.
> Performance mods for smoother gameplay.
> Quality-of-life features such as double doors, mouse tweaks, and world management.
> A few extra mobs that fit naturally into vanilla.

It’s still the Minecraft you know – just a little better.
